title: Mushroom Barley Soup
leftover_note: Reheats well; barley will absorb broth — add a splash of water when reheating.

items.prep: cleaned and rinsed in a colander
separated into leg and thigh, skin removed, seared with the vegetables

instructions: Sauté the onion and bay leaf in the margarine until tender. Add the chicken legs and sear a bit with the vegetables.
Add the mushrooms and sauté until the onions are golden.
Push the vegetables aside and stir in the flour until smooth.
Gradually stir in the water. Add the remaining ingredients (barley, celery, carrots, salt, pepper).
Bring to a boil and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

tips.title: Hearty meat variation
tips.text: For a hearty meat soup, add 1 1/2 portions of flanken with the water and cook as above. (With flanken this becomes a meat soup.)

notes: By Meichal Weingarten, cookbook page photo. Family note: the carrot was handwritten as 2 (applied). Family update: the flanken variation is replaced by chicken legs (separated into leg and thigh, skin removed, seared with the vegetables) - mandatory, not optional - so the soup is now a meat soup as written. A couple of other handwritten notes on the page were too hard to read and were not applied.
